sentences.text:
1. Heard Shri Ramakar Shukla, the learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Alok Kumar Tiwari, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.26 of 2025 under Sections 376, 506 IPC & Section 5/6 of P.O.C.S.O. Act registered at Police Station- Haliapur, District- Sultanpur.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 04.04.2025 in furtherance of an application under Section 173(4) BNSS, against the applicant, his father and uncle,
stating that the applicant is the son of the informant's step brother and resides in an adjacent house.

About a decade ago, when the informant was aged 14 years, the applicant entangled her in a love affair and under allurement of marrying her, he kept on making physical relationship with her repetitively and ultimately, he declined to marry her.
5. The victim stated that she got pregnant due to physical relations made by the applicant.

sentences.text: In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 180 B.N.S.S., she reiterated the FIR version.
7. The victim declined to under go internal medico-legal examination and her external medico-legal examination report reveals no mark of injury or sign of use of force.

As per the educational documents, the date of birth of the victim is 08.05.1997.
8.
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 B.N.S.S., she reiterated her earlier version.

9. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is a young man aged 26 years having no criminal history and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
10. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application and he has submitted that the information of the present application has been delivered to the informant through police.

He has further submitted that the allegations have been established during investigation and a charge-sheet has been submitted on 22.05.2025.
11.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that as per the FIR version, the applicant is the informant's nephew, the informant claims to have continued in a relationship with him for about a decade without any protest; that the applicant is a young man aged 26 years having no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 23.04.2025 whereas the investigation already stands concluded, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
12. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
-Amit K-
